description: One simulation run (CONVENTIONS section 6). Written to sim/runs/<run_id minus 'run.'>/summary.json: small, text-only, the thing Claude reads. The run_id encodes the start time and nothing else in the record is time-dependent; every metric is deterministic given the same inputs and seed. Units are SI except angles in degrees, named in the key suffix.

support_margin_min_m.description: Minimum over steps with floor contact of the signed distance, m, from the CoM's ground projection to the boundary of the convex hull of floor-contact points (positive inside). A hull of fewer than three non-collinear points gives zero or less. Null when no step touched the floor (gantry).

checks.description: Model checks as known when the run started. passed and failed list the check IDs from checks/last_run.json; waived lists the confirmed waivers in checks/waivers.yaml.

failed.description: IDs of checks that failed (and are not waived) in the last check run.

passed.description: IDs of checks that passed in the last check run.

status_model_sha256.description: Model hash the check status was computed for; null if checks/last_run.json is missing or predates the hash field.

status_stale.description: True when the check status was computed for a different model hash than this run's (or its hash is unknown).

waived.description: IDs with a confirmed waiver in checks/waivers.yaml.

additionalProperties.description: Contact metrics for all geoms of one foot body against the floor.

friction_ratio_peak.description: Maximum over window steps with summed normal force of at least 1 N of (tangential force / normal force); null if no step reached 1 N.

normal_force_peak_n.description: Maximum over the window of the normal force summed over the foot's floor contacts, N.

contacts.description: Per-foot floor contact metrics keyed foot_right and foot_left; empty in gantry mode.

controller.description: The controller in sim/controllers/ used for a 'controller' drive; empty strings for inverse-dynamics playback.

version.description: Controller version string, bumped when its behaviour changes.

diagnostics.description: Scenario-specific named measurements (for example settled penetration, total normal force and body weight in a standing hold). Keys carry their unit suffix.

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the output of `git diff HEAD`; null when the tree is clean.

env.description: Versions of the software the run used.

git_commit.description: HEAD commit of the repo when the run started.

git_dirty.description: True when tracked files differ from HEAD (git diff HEAD is non-empty). Untracked files do not count.

additionalProperties.description: Per-joint metrics over the measurement window. Torque is about the model's own hinge axes (the decoupled hip architecture): it is NOT actuator torque for the coupled-hip variant; the mapping to actuator space happens later. Positive torque and angle follow the model's sign convention (the sign of the joint axis in freyja.xml).

limit_hit_fraction.description: Fraction of window steps within 0.1 degrees of either limit; null if the joint is unlimited.

power_peak_w.description: Maximum over the window of |torque x velocity|, W.

rom_limit_deg.description: The model's joint range [lower, upper], degrees; null if the joint is unlimited.

rom_used_deg.description: Signed [min, max] of the joint angle over the window, degrees, in the model's sign convention.

speed_peak_rad_s.description: Maximum absolute joint velocity over the window, rad/s.

torque_peak_nm.description: Maximum absolute joint torque over the window, N m.

torque_rms_nm.description: Time root-mean-square of joint torque over the window, N m.

torque_source.description: Where the torque came from. 'applied' = ideal joint torque written to qfrc_applied during forward dynamics (ground mode). 'inverse_dynamics' = mj_inverse with prescribed qacc, used only in gantry mode where nothing touches the floor.

joints.description: Metrics for each joint that was measured, keyed by joint name.

outcome.description: completed, fell (pelvis height or trunk tilt past the scenario thresholds) or diverged (non-finite state or an unstable-simulation warning from MuJoCo).

run_id.description: run.<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMM>-<scenario>; the start time of the run.

scenario.description: The scenario file's content that defines the run.

name.description: Scenario name (the file name of sim/scenarios/<name>.yaml).

params.description: All scenario parameters as authored, including drive type, PD gains and any integrator or timestep override.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Any change after the first committed run bumps the version.

seed.description: Random seed for the run (scenario file); metrics are deterministic given it.

skipped.description: Joints a scenario did not exercise, with the reason. 'unlimited' = the model has no range for the joint, so no sweep span is invented.

snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of params/snapshot.csv (the full 64 hex characters).

support.description: 'ground' = standing on the floor, forward dynamics. 'gantry' = the pelvis is held, nothing touches the floor, inverse dynamics.

window.description: The measurement window; every metric is computed over it.

end_s.description: Window end, s of simulated time.

start_s.description: Window start, s of simulated time.
